says: In next/, this slice made the runner's saved Cmd a union, dispatched or waiting_answer, told apart by a state literal and not by a _tag written by Schema.TaggedUnion, against decision 0214. The state field was already there before the slice, so moving to _tag changes the saved checkpoint shape. Smallest fix: make it a TaggedUnion and read the old state form once when loading, or record why the saved field keeps its name. I missed this case of class 3 in the first review.
proof: Runner.ts:209-211: Schema.Union([Schema.Struct({ ...CommandFields, state: Schema.Literal("dispatched") }), Schema.Struct({ ...CommandFields, state: Schema.Literal("waiting_answer"), answer: Schema.Json })]).
cost: One saved union in the slice is read by a key other than _tag.
